title: CORE Dashboard
description: A CORE Dashboard model. It is the authoritative configuration for the dashboard rendered by an engine such as Superset.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this Dashboard.

released.description: Whether CORE releases this dashboard in the dashboard engine.

standaloneMode.description: Superset standalone display mode included in the portal link.

showFilters.description: Whether the dashboard link shows the native filter bar.

filterExpansion.description: Initial native filter bar state in the dashboard link.
